app.title: PDF TOOLS
app.description: PDF tools for processing documents locally.
app.metaDescription: Merge, convert, extract, delete, reorder, compress, and rotate PDFs locally.
app.privacy: Temporary files are deleted after each operation.

exportOptions.saveLocationHint: When you start the export, choose a location in the Save As dialog. If it is unavailable, the standard browser download is used.
exportOptions.invalidName: Enter a valid filename without a path or prohibited characters.
exportOptions.savePickerFailed: Could not open the Save As dialog.
exportOptions.saveFailed: Could not save the file to the selected location.

merge.title: Merge PDFs
merge.description: Combine multiple PDF documents in the order you choose.

extract.title: Extract pages
extract.description: Keep only the pages you need.

delete.title: Delete pages
delete.description: Remove unwanted pages from a PDF document.

reorder.title: Reorder pages
reorder.description: Drag the thumbnails to change the order of the pages.

compress.title: Compress a PDF
compress.description: Optimize your PDF structure without reducing the quality of its content.

rotate.title: Rotate pages
rotate.description: Rotate every page or only the pages you select.

imagesToPdf.title: Convert images to PDF
imagesToPdf.description: Combine your PNG or JPEG images into a PDF in the order you choose.

pdfToImages.title: Convert a PDF to images
pdfToImages.description: Export every page as PNG or JPEG in a ZIP archive.

files.dropDescription: or browse files on your computer
files.dropMultipleDescription: Click to browse and add multiple files
files.imageDropDescription: Add PNG or JPEG images in the order you want
files.imageLimit: PNG or JPEG · 500 MB maximum per file
files.singleOnly: Select one PDF file for this operation.
files.imageSingleOnly: Select one image for this operation.
files.selectImagePdf: Select at least one PNG or JPEG image.
files.notImage: “{{name}}” is not a PNG or JPEG image.

merge.stepFilesDescription: Documents will be combined in the order shown.
merge.stepOutputDescription: A single PDF will be downloaded automatically.
merge.privacy: Files are sent to the local server only when you merge them.
merge.minimumFiles: Add at least two PDF files to merge.

compress.stepOutputDescription: Lossless optimization may reduce the document size depending on its contents.
compress.privacy: Files are sent to the local server for processing, then temporary files are deleted.

imagesToPdf.stepFilesDescription: Each image becomes a page in the PDF.
imagesToPdf.stepOutputDescription: Images will be combined in the order shown.
imagesToPdf.privacy: Images are sent to the local server only when you convert them.

pdfToImages.stepOutputDescription: Each page will be exported into a ZIP archive.
pdfToImages.privacy: The PDF is processed in your browser and is not uploaded to the server.
pdfToImages.canvasUnavailable: This browser cannot create the page images.
pdfToImages.failed: Converting the PDF to images failed.
pdfToImages.archiveFailed: Could not create the ZIP archive.

pages.extractDescription: The new PDF will contain only the pages you specify.
pages.deleteDescription: The PDF must keep at least one page.
pages.help: Separate page numbers with commas or use ranges, for example 1,3,7 or 2-4,8.
pages.privacy: Files are sent to the local server for processing, then temporary files are deleted.

reorder.stepFileDescription: Thumbnails are generated in your browser.
reorder.dropDescription: The file is sent to the server only after you confirm the order.
reorder.stepPagesDescription: Drag pages or use the keyboard to move them.
reorder.previewFailed: Could not create thumbnails for this PDF.
reorder.canvasUnavailable: This browser cannot generate page thumbnails.
reorder.selectAndWait: Select a PDF and wait for thumbnails to finish loading.

rotate.heading: Choose pages and angle
rotate.description: Leave the page field empty to rotate the entire document.
rotate.pagesHelp: Leave empty for every page, or enter page numbers/ranges (e.g. 1,3,7 or 2-4,8).
